fields.captureRule: At actual staple emission count existing after.buildings kind weaver_house, not constructionSites, not current read-time buildings. Positive count -> present; zero -> absent. Valid complete building list required. Do not infer actual sales, profit, household occupation or historical causation; price effect is game balance only.

fields.captureRule: Require event guild_dispute and after.reorganisation.guild exists. Snapshot guild.headId: nonempty string -> identified, null -> unidentified; missing/empty/malformed unknown. No inferred death, vacancy cause, weakness, or outcome. Names resolved only at reading if future formatter adds ID slot.

fields.captureRule: Capture return moved from exact post construction call sourceRef claim market_fire/detail repair. Compare positive configured marketFireRepair with -moved: equal full, positive smaller partial, zero zero. Safe integer bounds and exact call correlation required; aggregate tick treasury delta is insufficient. Do not infer burned building IDs, casualty extent, completion, debt, or unpaid remainder obligation.

fields.captureRule: At the exact addPetition church_rebuilding point read treasuryBalance and configured churchRebuildingCost; finite nonnegative safe coin and positive safe cost required. coin>=cost covers_cost else below_cost. Capture operation-local state to avoid later same-tick effects. Not an approval, future affordability, reserved fund, physical church audit, or payment.

fields.captureRule: Capture exact accept answer post church_rebuilding source claim church_rebuilding/detail nave and false->true naveRebuilt. -moved==cost -> full; 0<-moved<cost -> partial; moved0 -> zero. Validate safe integers, record binding. Flag is set immediately even if payment is partial/zero. No construction site, physical nave completion, labour, or remaining debt inferred.

fields.captureRule: At factionChanges deposition branch capture exact Math.round((start-crown.relation)*depositionPermille/1000) before delta filtering, with crown present and finite valid relation/start. Positive -> toward_closer, negative -> toward_distant, zero -> unchanged. Capture local contribution, not total after-minus-before relation if other causes share tick. No inference of player loyalty, dynastic cause, reward or punishment.
